steps.say: The Earth is surrounded by a layer of air called the atmosphere. It is a mixture of gases.
About four fifths of the air is nitrogen. About one fifth is oxygen, which living things need to breathe. There are small amounts of other gases such as carbon dioxide.
Most water on Earth is not pure. Seawater has salt dissolved in it, and rainwater and river water contain dissolved substances too.
Pollution is when humans add substances to the environment that harm living things.
Smoke pollutes air. Rubbish and chemicals pollute water and soil. We can reduce pollution by reusing, recycling and cleaning up.
